GREEN.label: Monitoring
GREEN.description: No canary milestones triggered. Quantum computing progressing but no cryptographically relevant demonstrations.

YELLOW.label: Milestones Triggered
YELLOW.description: Significant milestones confirm quantum progress toward cryptographic relevance. Does not indicate imminent threat.

ORANGE.label: Watch Closely
ORANGE.description: Timeline compressing. Conditions for a cryptographic break are forming.

RED.label: Canary Down
RED.description: Cryptographically relevant quantum factoring demonstrated. Remaining gap to Q-Day is an engineering problem.

triggered.event: NIST finalizes first 3 post-quantum encryption standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA)
Ethereum adds PQC to 'The Splurge' roadmap phase
DOE Genesis Mission announced — fault-tolerant quantum by 2028
Google Willow chip — 105 qubits with below-threshold error correction
Ethereum forms dedicated post-quantum security team
US EO 14412 + OMB M-26-15 mandate federal PQC migration with enforcement deadlines (HVAs: key establishment by 2030, digital signatures by 2031; full federal migration by 2035)
US EO 14413 establishes QC-ADDS — directs DOE to field a large-scale quantum computer (no delivery deadline)
First verified AI-discovered break of a standardization-track cryptographic scheme (HAWK-256, Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview; HAWK withdrawn from NIST process)

Google demonstrates magic state cultivation on Willow (Science) — 40x error reduction, 99.99% T-state fidelity (8% of attempts kept), color-to-surface code grafting; validates a core assumption behind the <500,000-qubit ECDLP-256 estimate

watch_items.event: DOE/IBM deliver fault-tolerant systems on 2028-29 timelines
